description: Start, stop, restart, suspend, resume or hard-reset a VM. Stopped VMs keep their disk and IP and are still billed. Returns the VM with its new status.

action.description: Power action. Use "reset" only when "restart" does not respond.

dry_run.description: Preview the action without executing it. Returns what would happen, including cost estimates. Always dry-run first for anything that costs money.

name: edge_vm_power
